title: New High-Throughput Screen Discovers Novel Ligands of Full-Length Nuclear Receptor LRH-1.
authors: Malabanan, M Merced; Chapagain, Pratima; Haratipour, Zeinab; Choi, Woong Jae; Orun, Abigail R; Blind, Raymond D
one_liner_zh: 该文开发高通量FRET筛选发现核受体LRH-1配体，虽涉及转录因子与DNA靶基因调控，但核心是配体结合与功能筛选，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅计算对接辅助，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Nuclear receptor liver receptor homolog-1 (LRH-1, NR5A2) is a lipid-regulated transcription factor and an important drug target for several liver diseases. Advances toward LRH-1 therapeutics have been driven recently by structural biology, with fewer contributions from compound screening. Standard LRH-1 screens detect compound-induced interaction between LRH-1 and a transcriptional coregulator peptide, an approach that excludes compounds that regulate LRH-1 through alternative mechanisms. Here, we developed a FRET-based LRH-1 screen that simply detects compound binding to LRH-1, applying it to discover 58 new compounds that bind the canonical ligand-binding site in LRH-1 (2.5% hit rate), also supported by computational docking. Four independent functional screens identified 15 of these 58 compounds to also regulate LRH-1 function in vitro or in living cells. Although one of these 15 compounds, abamectin, directly binds LRH-1 and regulates full-length LRH-1 in cells, abamectin failed to regulate the isolated ligand-binding domain in standard coregulator peptide recruitment assays using PGC1alpha, DAX-1, or SHP. Abamectin treatment of human liver HepG2 cells selectively regulated endogenous LRH-1 ChIP-seq target genes and pathways associated with known LRH-1 functions in bile acid and cholesterol metabolism. Thus, the screen reported here can discover compounds not likely to have been identified in standard LRH-1 compound screens but which bind and regulate full-length LRH-1 in cells.
abstract_zh: 核受体肝脏受体同源物-1（LRH-1, NR5A2）是一种脂质调控的转录因子，也是多种肝脏疾病的重要药物靶点。近年来，LRH-1治疗药物的进展主要由结构生物学推动，而化合物筛选的贡献较少。标准LRH-1筛选检测化合物诱导的LRH-1与转录共调节因子肽之间的相互作用，这种方法排除了通过其他机制调控LRH-1的化合物。在此，我们开发了一种基于FRET的LRH-1筛选方法，仅检测化合物与LRH-1的结合，并应用该方法发现了58个与LRH-1中经典配体结合位点结合的新化合物（命中率为2.5%），同时通过计算对接进一步支持。四个独立的功能筛选确定这58个化合物中有15个还能在体外或活细胞中调控LRH-1功能。尽管这15个化合物中的一种，阿维菌素（abamectin），直接结合LRH-1并在细胞中调控全长LRH-1，但在使用PGC1alpha、DAX-1或SHP的标准共调节因子肽招募实验中，阿维菌素未能调控分离的配体结合域。对人肝脏HepG2细胞进行阿维菌素处理，选择性地调控了内源性LRH-1 ChIP-seq靶基因及与已知LRH-1在胆汁酸和胆固醇代谢中功能相关的通路。因此，本研究报告的筛选方法能够发现那些在标准LRH-1化合物筛选中可能未被识别，但能在细胞中结合并调控全长LRH-1的化合物。
